items.title: AI 데이터센터 구축 빨라진다…인허가 일괄처리·평가 특례 마련
items.rationale: Policy axis, primary document: the Ministry of Science and ICT pre-announced the enforcement decree and rules of the AI Data Center Industry Promotion Special Act (in force next March), covering AIDC recognition and notification, bundled permitting, a grid-impact assessment waiver for non-capital-region sites of 50MW or less, and AIDC special-zone criteria. Public comment runs to Dec 30.
items.excerpt: 과기정통부가 'AI 데이터센터 산업 진흥 특별법'(내년 3월 시행) 시행령·시행규칙 제정안을 12월 30일까지 입법예고 — AIDC 인정 기준·신고제, 인허가 일괄처리, 비수도권 50MW 이하 전력계통영향평가 면제, AIDC 특구 기준.

items.title: Senator proposes select committee on AI as Democrats hope to move quickly to regulate it
items.rationale: Policy axis, new proposal: Sen. John Hickenlooper sent letters to Schumer and Van Hollen proposing a Senate select committee on AI, with priorities named as third-party evaluation requirements, national-security mitigation and accountability rules. This is a separate action from the House Jacobs/Maloy/Beyer outline published 11-20. Positions are attributed to the senator.
items.excerpt: Sen. John Hickenlooper proposed, in letters to Schumer and Van Hollen, a Senate select committee on AI, with priorities of third-party evaluation requirements, national-security mitigation and accountability rules as Democrats prepare for the January majority.

items.title: Several Member States call on European Commission to propose legislation to better protect copyright from AI
items.rationale: Policy axis (copyright), new official action: 14 EU member states formally asked the Commission to propose legislation that strengthens copyright protection against AI training and guarantees fair pay for creators. This is a separate move from the Digital Omnibus negotiating stance published 10-24. The outlet is not on the whitelist, and no listed outlet covered it inside the window.
items.excerpt: Fourteen EU member states urged the Commission to propose swift legislation strengthening copyright protection against AI and ensuring fair remuneration for creators.

items.title: Influencer deepfakes used to stoke Canada-US tensions
items.rationale: Elections/public-opinion axis, new research release: a McGill Centre for Media, Technology and Democracy study found about 300 Instagram and TikTok accounts using AI-altered likenesses of real creators, with AI-written scripts, to inflame Canada-US trade-war discourse (thousands of videos, about 20 million views). Findings are attributed to the study.
items.excerpt: A McGill Centre for Media, Technology and Democracy study found about 300 Instagram and TikTok accounts using AI-altered likenesses of real creators, with AI-written scripts, to inflame Canada-US trade-war discourse — thousands of videos and about 20 million views.

items.title: The Role of AI in Enforcing China's Ethnic Unity Law
items.rationale: Policy/geopolitics axis: an article-by-article reading of China's new Ethnic Unity Law shows that its content-deletion duties (Art. 31), early-warning systems (Art. 52) and minority-language digitalization (Art. 15) rely on AI, and that the law reaches generative-AI model providers. This is a different law from the AI-lifecycle regulation published 11-04.
items.excerpt: An article-by-article reading of China's new Ethnic Unity Law shows how its content-deletion duties (Art. 31), early-warning systems (Art. 52) and minority-language digitalization (Art. 15) depend on AI for policing, learning and enforcement — and extend to generative-AI model providers.
